title: 小倉記念の後に・三つ眼はなくとも

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I blew right through the Kokura Kinen! You can just call me Matikane-kokura from now on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Actually, scratch that. That one's a little much, even for me. But anyway…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I believe we promised to go somewhere together! Onwards, to the other most sacred spot in Fukuoka.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The street food district of Hakata, obviously! Bowing your head before a divine bowl of ramen will earn you a heavenly reward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's so good and packed with nutrients! Nothing beats the rich juiciness of tonkotsu ramen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Come on! Let us partake of the nectar of the gods and have ourselves a divine feast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what this has to do with the gods, but we both enjoy a bowl of ramen together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have an idea for our next race. I'd like to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It was only the compassion from my devoted fans that got me a spot in the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But this time, I want to actually earn all those votes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's take all these wishes we've gathered and bring them to Nakayama at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Do you mean it? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My senior year is finally coming to a close. Let's finish it off just like we did those bowls of ramen!
